text:
nisha: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a lightweight access "entropy sanitization" sweep against org-admins this morning. Goal: remove obviously stale entitlements and produce a short handoff doc.


dave: cool, what's the filtering logic? last time the sweep removed an account we shouldn't have.

maria: agreed — can we run a read-only canary first and surface candidates for manual review?

nisha: yes — two phases: 1) observational canary that only lists candidate principals, 2) staged removal (manual approval). Canary will use heuristics: 90d no console/API activity + 0 KMS key grants in 180d + not in svc-owner allowlist.

ryan: can you paste the audit query? would like to run it locally.

nisha: sure — using our log-ql (from audit-index):

```
# candidates: no interactive or api activity in 90d, no kms_grant in 180d
filter service in ("console", "api") | where timestamp > now() - 90d | distinct principal as active_principals
join kind=left principals_table on principals_table.principal != active_principals
where principals_table.last_kms_grant < now() - 180d and principals_table.role in ("org-admin","project-admin")
project principal, email, last_seen=principals_table.last_seen, last_kms_grant=principals_table.last_kms_grant
```

maria: nice. Add a column for `owner_contact` so we ping the right person. Also flag any principals with multi-factor disabled.

nisha: will do. also wiring KMS cross-account grants into the query was a pain (we had to normalize grant events from 3 sources). FYI I pushed a small helper script to the infra repo: https://git.company/redwood/sec/entropy-scripts

sec-bot: [automated] Canary run queued by nisha for workspace:infra. Expected runtime ~4m. 

ops-jun: ping when canary output is ready, I can help triage noisy hits. Also suggest we exclude service accounts used by our batch inference pipeline — they have low interactive activity but are live.

nisha: good catch — added a temporary allowlist: `svc:inference-*`, `svc:batch-*`. Will enumerate via label:team=inference.

ryan: quick Q — for staged removal, do we revoke IAM roles or rotate keys? what's our remediation step?

nisha: staged removal runbook draft: 1) open a GH PR with `entitlement-sanitization/` changes (list of principals to remove) 2) assign owners and 72h review window, 3) if no objection, execute `iam revoke-role` + rotate affected service keys if `last_used < 30d` (for non-human). For KMS grants we remove `Decrypt` and `GenerateDataKey` grants first and monitor alerts for 24h.

maria: suggest we also create a short audit log entry for each revoked principal linking to the PR and reason. Ops can consume that for post-mortem.

nisha: yep — will annotate with `revocation_reason` and `evidence_link`. Also adding a temporary trace-id to correlate: `sanit-$(date +%s)` in playbooks.

dave: how do we handle emergency rollbacks if we accidentally hit a live user?

nisha: rollback plan: restore IAM binding from the PR (we keep reversal patch), re-grant KMS grants via recorded grant IDs, and run smoke tests for affected services. Ops has a 2hr SLA for rollback.

ops-jun: can we add an auto-alert to #eng-oncall if any removals affect >1 production svc?

maria: yes — rule: if revoked principal matches label:component=prod and affects >1 endpoint, post to #release-war-room and page oncall.

sec-bot: [automated] Canary run complete: 42 candidate principals found. Report: https://git.company/redwood/sec/reports/sanit-1745008765.csv

nisha: uploaded the CSV and a short checklist to the PR: https://git.company/redwood/sec/pulls/3124 — tagging owners. Please review 24h. :eyes:

ryan: reviewing now. will surface any noisy false positives. thanks for limiting this to a canary first. :thumbsup:

maria: once we run one full cycle, let's add a scheduled weekly diff to the console so teams see drift. visibility reduces surprise.

nisha: agreed. plan is: weekly canary report, monthly staged removal window, quarterly full review with exec attestation. I'll post an ops calendar invite after PR merges.

dave: thanks — lgtm for the process. If you want, I can run a quick smoke test harness after revocations.

nisha: appreciated. will coordinate.

sec-bot: [automated] Reminder: owners must ACK PR within 24h or entitlements move to staged removal queue.

maria: acked.

ops-jun: acked.

ryan: acked.

nisha: closing the loop: once staged removals start I'll post before/after KMS grant diffs and evidence.

maria: perfect. thanks team.
